content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to ask if it's possible to control [product_name] using a PLC module like [product_name] version [version_no]? Can I set this up using [product_name] software, or will I need other software such as [product_name] version [version_no]?
No, [product_name] software is only for programming [product_name] base modules.

Okay, I'll use [product_name] software for programming [product_name], but I'm not certain if [product_name] can be set up to work with [product_name]. It seems possible with the PLC module, but the question is if it will function without another program like [product_name], or if I'll have to purchase something like [product_name] software.

What exactly do you mean by configure? Are you asking if [product_name] can communicate with [product_name]? It could work with a [product_name] CPU, but not directly with [product_name] modules. [product_name] supports Ethernet TCP/IP with the S7 protocol, and since version [version_no] also supports Modbus TCP/IP. However, [product_name] does not support: Profinet I/O or Profibus DP.
Why did you change the language? This forum operates in English. Please make sure to write your posts in English.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to resolve how [product_name] and [product_name] modules can work together, specifically regarding control and configuration using only [product_name] software. There is confusion about required software and compatible communication protocols. Replies clarify that [product_name] software programs only [product_name] modules, and direct control of [product_name] modules is not feasible except through certain protocols like Ethernet S7 or Modbus TCP/IP, depending on [product_name] version.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects that [product_name] could directly control or configure [product_name] modules using just [product_name] software, without needing additional purchases. The user hopes for a simple setup process to integrate these devices.
